name: ms-corporate-income-tax
description: Montserrat company income tax for 2026 under the Income and Corporation Tax Act, Chapter 17.01 (revised to 1 January 2025). Covers the 30% rate on chargeable income (section 36), deductible and non-deductible expenses (sections 13 to 16), the return by 31 March with a tax calculation (section 43), payment by 30 June or 45 days after assessment, the three equal instalments in February, April and June (section 50), the 15% deduction from Government contract payments (section 37), company-specific rate orders and the branch remitted-profit charge. Trigger phrases include Montserrat corporation tax, Montserrat company tax 30%, Montserrat tax instalments.
